GTA 6 pre-load date confirmed by Rockstar

Rockstar Games has confirmed that pre-loading for Grand Theft Auto VI opens on 17 November 2026 on both PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S, two days before the game's release on 19 November.

The company said the download is expected to be large and recommended that players free up storage space in advance. Exact file sizes were not given in the announcement, and Rockstar said further details would follow on its Newswire.

Players who bought the game digitally will see the pre-load option appear in their library automatically once it opens. Physical copies will still require a day-one patch, according to the statement.
